scope: Two new PLOS documents; numeric bracket groups on first four physical pages; 9 aligned groups, 21 linked reference targets. Development feasibility only, not superscript or unseen-confirmation evidence.

recovered_body_number_but_wrong_target.explanation: A real bibliography OCR error relabels printed23as3; local bracket repair is followed by a wrong link, which both consistency tests accept.

evaluation_notes: Target identity and faithful entry boundaries are reported separately; merged entries can identify a leading target but do not count as clean complete relations.
Anchor correctness means the source callout location (all 9 manually reviewed); this pilot does not demonstrate sentence-level span reconstruction.
One real [16-20] callout per method is unscored because strict JATS/PDF context alignment failed; it is not counted as a false insertion.
All emitted predictions on the eight body pages were checked; there were no noncitation insertions, but the scoring denominator is only the aligned subset.
Reference numbers and rid mappings from PDF/JATS were never supplied to inference.
CEX/GROBID and OCR-EDR were not run; no strong-baseline superiority is claimed.
decision: DO_NOT_INITIATE_FULL_PROJECT; close this frozen candidate version, no threshold search or data expansion
input_origin: Unmodified publisher PDF pages rasterized at150dpi, not scanned/camera-captured documents; actual OCR errors, no manually deleted text
restart_requirements: Suitable independently grouped citation-relation truth with source pixel alignment and a relevant superscript/scanned-document error distribution
An independent pixel-based check that rejects wrong-but-existing reference IDs, including reference-list misrecognition
Strictly positive complete-relation gain over the same-budget local baseline without increased wrong links, then independent document confirmation
